## What's new in 1.5.3

- **Android updates install properly from now on.** Until now every release was signed with a different key, so Android refused to install an update over the app already on the phone ("App not installed") and the old version kept running — for example still showing the old icon in the background notification after "updating" to 1.5.2. From 1.5.3 every release is signed with one fixed key, so future updates install over the previous version and keep your settings.

> **⚠️ Android: uninstall once before installing 1.5.3.** Because the old versions used throw-away keys, 1.5.3 can't install over them. Uninstall Gundil Intercom, install the 1.5.3 APK, then enter your saved peers, device name and intercom password again. This is needed only this one time.

- Includes everything from 1.5.2 (new app icon, version shown in the app) and 1.5.1 (smooth switching between Wi-Fi, mobile data and VPNs; calls survive a network switch).
- Windows, Linux and the headless node: nothing changes; update as usual.

Upgrading: works with 1.2.0 – 1.5.2. Versions before 1.2.0 (including 1.1.1) can't connect, because they don't encrypt. Check the version under the app title: it should read **v1.5.3**.
